title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred College on 1970-05-01

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with a ripping 'The Race Is On' and clear, high‑quality audio
ai_review.review: The reviewer is thrilled by the performance of "The Race Is On," calling it a grin‑inducing highlight. They also praise the recording quality, noting it sounds great and is enjoyable to listen to.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review, but it emphasizes both stellar performance of the cover song and high recording quality, leading to a strong positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes love the quality; no complaints about muddiness, drop‑outs, or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic early show with a fun, high‑energy cover that stands out for the audience.
